basis.governed_note: 6 mph = OWNER-SELECTED governed maximum (28 Oct 2026); hard hydraulic limit = H1B minimum-displacement stop at 60 cc (tamper-sealed) + PLUS+1 pump speed control + independent overspeed trip 7 mph (ASSUMED) -> emergency brake. PE to confirm.

components.reducer: Dodge Torque-Arm II TA7315H15MS x 120 mm straight bore, part 907012, ratio 14.9, 226.8 kg (catalog)
components.motor: Danfoss H1B110 SAE-D (152-4) flange, 110/22 cc (min setting 22-74 cc), electric proportional control L* or two-position with PCOR (T*/P*), speed sensor (VS housing), 48.8 kg; 1.75 N.m/bar; rated 2,900 rpm @max / 4,800 @min disp; max working 450 bar
components.belt: 1:1 synchronous belt drop (Gates Poly Chain GT Carbon 14MGT class, ~Ø160 sprockets, c-c ~195) - catalog parts, rating AWAIT Gates
components.pump: Danfoss H1P053 kept (G1 shaft, L35 PL 350 / HPRV 400, AC-2 or EDC + PLUS+1 anti-stall)

start.note: Adhesion-limited: pressure need only reach ~262 bar for the 2% start; still holds at a pessimistic start eta 0.80 (294 bar)

speed.spin_note: If one wheelset spins while the others stick, it can take all pump flow: 60 cc stop -> 2106 rpm (< 2,900 motor rated) but > 1,790 TA II input max -> per-motor speed sensors + PLUS+1 anti-slip destroke REQUIRED (spec); with 22 cc it would be 5743 rpm (> 4,800 rated)

power_speed.method: 35 kW pump allowance x pump 0.855 x motor 0.92 hm x 0.95 vol x dp/(dp+10) x reducer 0.96 x belt 0.97; motor at the displacement that holds dp<=350, not below the 60 cc stop

adhesion_as_running_SF1.note: even a sustained slip-limit pull is inside the SF 1.0 running rating

reducer.note: Catalog is for electric-motor industrial drives; Dodge requires Application Engineering review for a non-electric prime mover / heavy shock -> AWAIT Dodge AE (rail traction not a catalog application)

motor.control: H1B electric proportional (L*) driven by PLUS+1: starts at max displacement (max start torque), destrokes toward the 60 cc stop with speed; PCOR (pressure compensator override, option T*/P* family) returns motor toward max displacement when loop pressure rises (hill/start) = hydraulic anti-stall/auto-downshift; BPD (brake pressure defeat) keeps PCOR from fighting dynamic braking. Pump anti-stall (engine droop) unchanged on H1P053.
motor.min_stop: minimum-displacement limiter screw set to 60 cc and lock-wired/sealed (6 mph). Hardware can be reset to 22 cc for ~10 mph capability (not permitted in service).
motor.brake: H1B has NO brake -> axle disc + 2 spring-applied calipers per powered axle (B1)
motor.speed_sensor: VS/DS housing with speed sensor port - order with sensor (overspeed + anti-slip)

EN13103_screen.note: EN 13103 has no keyed-seat permissible -> Shigley/Goodman fatigue with key Kf, required n >= 1.5 (ASSUMED)

axle.result: FAILS as a plain 4140 Ø120 profile keyseat (n 0.96). FIX APPLIED: 34CrNiMo6 (EN 10083-3) Q&T Rm>=1000, sled-runner keyseat 32x11 (catalog 32x11x269), induction-hardened + ground seat zone (k 1.5 ASSUMED, PE/metallurgist to confirm) -> n 1.82. TA9415H Ø125 alone gives n 1.42 (rejected: +117 kg/axle, larger housing, still needs the material change).

key.size: 32x11 keyseat x 269 (Dodge 120 mm bore), ISO key 32x18 C45

axle.fit: Dodge straight bore is a slip fit: specify shaft k6 (AWAIT Dodge), anti-fretting compound, Dodge setscrews + axial retaining collar; check key/seat for reversing traction torque at each 500 h inspection

torque_arm.layout: Dodge TA rod vertical (within the +/-30 deg Dodge rule) from the housing input-end fulcrum, up to a rubber-bushed anchor bracket PL20 cantilevered 155 mm from the transom's axle-side face (Z~1,000) - classic nose suspension, rides the primary-spring motion
torque_arm.weld: bracket PL20 to transom PL16: 2 x 200 x 10 fillet both sides (throat 2,828 mm2), S_weld = 2*200^2/6*7.07*... see PE C7n
torque_arm.note: Dodge TA rod itself rated by Dodge for the reducer torque (AWAIT AE for rail shock); bush the anchor end (rubber) for vertical/lateral compliance

belt.spec: Gates Poly Chain GT Carbon 14MGT 37-68 mm wide (catalog), rating >= 980 N.m at 50-900 rpm incl. SF 1.4 -> AWAIT Gates selection
belt.why: H1B110 in line with the TA II input shaft does not fit (see packaging): the belt drop moves the motor 195 mm further from the axle so it clears the horn cheeks and passes through the open sideframe window inside the wheel line

inline_motor.result: NO FIT: H1B110 SAE AA 316.4 + coupling puts the motor rear at Y491 vs sideframe 330 (X109-349 hits horn cheek X110-140) / wheel inner face 427

packaging.mirror: input ends point to the truck centre on both axles of each truck (mirrored in X); reducers on Y-, discs/motors/belts on Y+ (all 4 axles)

brake.disc: Ø340x25 on the axle, Y+190..215 (side away from the reducer)
brake.calipers: 2 x spring-applied air-released per disc (ref Coremo Ocmea D 3.5N 24.2 kN) - axle torque is now 1:1 (no gear multiplication)
brake.note: see PE B1-g: clamp per caliper with 2 calipers

options.pros: all catalog parts; adhesion-limited start at ~262 bar; 10 mph hardware capability on the existing H1P053; governed 6 mph by a hard min-displacement stop; same H1 family as the pump (one supplier/controls); no custom gears
options.cons: TA II is industrial (not rail-traction rated) - Dodge AE must accept; Ø120 keyed axle seat needs 34CrNiMo6 + induction hardening; belt drop + guard to maintain; H1B has no brake (axle disc + 2 calipers); heavier (+408 kg/axle hung)

options.pros: LSHT motor with built-in multi-disc brake; catalog parts
options.cons: Dodge must rate 5:1 below 90 rpm; ~7.4 mph flow cap on H1P053 (fine for 6 mph); MS05 length also needs the drop/space check; two suppliers

options.pros: designed to fit; rail-style nose suspension; Ø150 seat
options.cons: one-off gear case (design, cutting, heat treat, inspection) - owner not keen; start η 0.78 marginal pending Poclain; 7.4 mph flow cap
